ways.label: Lakehead Hut to Angelus Hut via the Cascade Track

start.name: Lakehead Hut
start.quote: From Lakehead Hut it is also 2 hr to the Cascade Track junction.

end.name: Angelus Hut
end.quote: Climb the steep poled route to Angelus Hut.

via.name: Cascade Track alongside the Hukere Stream
via.quote: From the Cascade Track junction it’s a steady climb for 4 hr alongside the Hukere Stream.

via.name: bush edge
via.quote: The track ends at the bush edge.

evidence: From Lakehead Hut it is also 2 hr to the Cascade Track junction. Note this includes crossing the unbridged Travers River.
From the Cascade Track junction it’s a steady climb for 4 hr alongside the Hukere Stream.
The track ends at the bush edge. Climb the steep poled route to Angelus Hut.

access_points.name: St Arnaud
access_points.quote: From St Arnaud the options are to walk to either Lakehead Hut (9 km, 3 hr) or Coldwater Hut (12 km, 4 hr).

not_on_route.name: Travers River swingbridge
not_on_route.quote: If the Travers River is in flood a swingbridge is located 1 hr 30 min upstream.

doubts: The page starts the description at St Arnaud but DOC's '6 hr' and '9.4 km one way' fit the hut-to-Angelus section, so the ways start at Lakehead Hut and Coldwater Hut, with St Arnaud recorded as an access point. Which hut is the main start is not stated; Lakehead Hut is taken because it is named first. It is not certain whether the unbridged Travers River crossing applies only to the Lakehead Hut approach. Coldwater Hut is on W2 only, so it is not listed under huts for the main way.
